hero.title: Tell <brand>Trawise</brand> where you want to stay. Let the places come to you.
hero.description: Drop a pin, set your budget and your dates. Hotels, guesthouses and hosts nearby see your request and reply with what they can offer — so you compare real answers instead of scrolling listings.
hero.free: Free to use, and Trawise never takes a cut — you pay the place directly.
hero.storeNote: The app is coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
hero.mapAlt: The Trawise app showing a map of Stockholm with five places within five kilometres of a dropped pin
hero.offerAlt: Two replies to one request — one place countered at 1,450 SEK a night, another accepted at 1,200 SEK

travellers.title: One request. Every place nearby answers.
travellers.subtitle: A booking site makes you check the same dates twenty times. Trawise turns it around: you ask once, and the places that can host you reply.

ask.title: Ask once
ask.description: Drop a pin, choose how far around it you are willing to go, and name your nights, your party and what you want to pay per night. The total and the number of places you reach update as you type.
ask.imageAlt: The new request form in the Trawise app: a budget of 700 SEK per night for a stay within two kilometres of Stockholm, reaching two places

answers.title: Read what comes back
answers.description: Every published place inside your area that can sleep your party on your dates sees the request. Each one accepts your budget, counters with a nightly price of its own, or passes. A counter is one round — you book it or you turn it down.
answers.imageAlt: A request for three nights in October at 1,200 SEK per night, with one offer accepted and one countered

book.title: Book the one you want
book.description: Booking a place declines the other offers and tells them, so nobody is holding a room you are not going to take. The street address and the host's contact details are shared with you once the stay is booked.
book.imageAlt: A place's listing in the app: photos, description, rating, and the nightly price it can host you for

why.title: Why it works out cheaper
why.subtitle: Not a discount code. A room that would sit empty on a Tuesday is worth more to a host at your price than at no price.

price.title: You name the price
price.description: You do not filter by someone else's number. You say what you want to pay per night, and a place decides whether it can fill those nights at that price.

fees.title: No fees, no middleman
fees.description: Trawise takes no cut, holds no deposit and charges no booking fee. You pay the place directly, with whichever methods it accepts.

forHosts.title: Empty rooms become income.
forHosts.subtitle: Travellers nearby say where they want to be, when, and what they can pay. You answer the ones that suit you, on the dates you still have free.

register.title: Register your place
register.descriptionBeforeEmail: Create a host account and add your hotel, guesthouse or flat, or email us at
register.descriptionAfterEmail: and we'll set it up for you.

receive.title: Receive requests
receive.description: Requests pinned inside an area that covers you, for dates you have rooms free, for a party your rooms can sleep.

decide.title: Compare and decide
decide.description: Price, dates and the traveller's rating side by side. Accept, counter or decline on the row.

welcome.title: Accept and welcome
welcome.description: Accept, and the traveller gets your address and your details for their arrival date.

forHosts.inboxAlt: The Trawise host dashboard, showing open requests with Accept, Counter and Decline on each row

lastMinute.title: Fill your last-minute vacancies
lastMinute.description: Turn empty rooms into bookings for the closest dates, with no long-term commitment.

reach.title: An extra marketing channel
reach.description: Reach travellers actively looking nearby, without spending on ads or promotions.

team.title: Your team, not your password
team.description: A place belongs to an organisation. Invite colleagues by email with a role that decides what each of them can do.

questions.title: Questions before you start?
questions.description: The FAQ covers what it costs, who can see your request, what a counter-offer is, and what happens after a place says yes.

footer.description: Connect with nearby hosts and find budget-friendly stays on Trawise

notFound.title: 404 — page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for doesn't exist. Let's get you back to finding somewhere to stay.

cookieBanner.message: We use cookies to improve your experience. Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors use our website.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.introMessage: We're sorry to see you go. You can delete your account in two ways:

viaAppSettings.title: In the app
viaAppSettings.description: Go to Settings, then Delete account, and confirm with your password.

requestHere.title: By email
requestHere.description: If you prefer, email us and we'll process your deletion request manually.

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: We're sorry, but something unexpected happened. Please try refreshing the page.

faq.subtitle: How Trawise works, what it costs, and what happens after a place says yes.
